verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents self-serve forwarding: mail forwarding is included in plans, packages can be shipped to any address with bundling savings, and users can request that mail be shipped unopened. It also offers automation rules, though these are not explicitly tied to forwarding. There is no evidence of saved recipient addresses, carrier selection, or a cost preview before confirming. Missing for 10: saved recipients, carrier choice, pre-confirmation cost display, explicit forwarding-specific rules or one-click flow, independent/hands-on corroboration.
